Binocular_Hunter_Eyes.description: The Binocular Hunter Eyes, with their wolf-like gleam, sharpen your senses, allowing you to track prey from afar with deadly precision. Their focused optics pierce through mist and shadow, granting an uncanny awareness of your surroundings.

Panoramic_Prey_Eyes.description: The Panoramic Prey Eyes grant a sweeping, deer-like vision, enhancing alertness with an all-encompassing peripheral awareness that boosts natural sense by three degrees.

Low_Light_Eyes.description: Low_Light_Eyes glow with an ethereal radiance, enhancing vision in shadowed realms. These cat-like eyes, with their tapetum lucidum, pierce darkness like a hunter's keen gaze, granting an edge in low-light environments.

Subterranean_Blind_Eyes.description: Subterranean Blind Eyes: Vestigial organs barely clinging to life, these mole-like eyes offer no vision but a faint tremor of presence detection, atrophied from centuries underground.

Infrared_Sensing_Eyes.description: The Infrared_Sensing_Eyes emit a faint, otherworldly glow, allowing their bearer to perceive the heat signatures of living beings with uncanny precision, as if seeing through the very essence of life itself.

Trichromatic_Versatile_Eyes.description: Trichromatic Versatile Eyes: These human-like eyes, imbued with an advanced color vision system, grant enhanced sensory perception, allowing for vivid and detailed visual experiences across a spectrum of light.
